info.name: Evolv
info.description:
This API provides Evolv customers the ability to integrate with the Evolv Platform in to way most optimal for their specific usecase.

Benefits

  • Speed to serve
    • Integrate server side to reduce the impact on page load time.
  • Secure
    • No clientside javascript required
  • Tight development integration
    • Build testing practices into the development flow
  • Optimize your full stack
    • Web interfaces, algorithms, mobile applications, serverside configuration

item.description:
Update the allocations of a specific user. For all experiments a participant is eligible for, this endpoint will return the candidate allocation they would receive. Note that they are not yet considered a part of the experiment.

This endpoint respects experiment throttling and audience filters.

item.description:
Inform Ascend of the experiment details. Primarily confirming a user into an experiment, recording conversion and sending general event information.

These events can be configured with targets to redirect to. This is useful in cases where the customer wants to record a conversion through the user clicking a link. The link can be configured to be a call to Ascend saying the goal has been achieved, then redirect on to the desired location.

item.name: preallocations

request.description:
If eid is provided, this request will return count preallocations for the specified experiment identifier.

If eid is not provided, this request will return an array of count preallocations for each experiment in the specified environment identifier.

description.content: The identifier of the experiment to generate preallocations for. This value is required.

response.name: Basic Response

query.description: The identifier of the experiment to generate preallocations for.
The number of preallocations to create.
